note: File Field Sources adds extra 'sources' to File/Image field widgets beside core Upload: remote (URL download), reference (existing managed file), attach (server directory), imce (IMCE browser, needs IMCE), clipboard. Sources are enabled per widget and stored as a third-party setting on the entity_form_display: content.<field>.third_party_settings.filefield_sources.filefield_sources.sources (map id=>id for enabled, id=>0 for disabled); 'upload' is auto-enabled. Supported widgets by default: file_generic, image_image (hook_filefield_sources_widgets). No settings page (configure=null). It defines the FilefieldSource plugin type (@FilefieldSource, manager plugin.manager.filefield_sources). Medium/hard cases create a real file field on Article and read/write that third-party setting.

evals.prompt: The Drupal filefield_sources module lets a File or Image field be filled from more than just an upload. Which additional sources does it provide out of the box?
evals.expected_output: Beside core's Upload, it provides: remote (download from a URL), reference (reuse an existing managed file by name), attach (pick from a server directory), imce (the IMCE file browser, if IMCE is installed), and clipboard (paste a file).

evals.prompt: How do I turn on filefield_sources options like 'Remote URL' for a specific File field in Drupal, and where is that choice saved? Note there is no dedicated admin settings page.
evals.expected_output: There is no settings page (configure=null). You enable sources per widget on the entity's Manage form display: open the File/Image field's widget settings, expand 'File sources', tick the sources. It is stored as a third-party setting on the widget component: core.entity_form_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.third_party_settings.filefield_sources.filefield_sources.sources.

evals.prompt: Which field widgets does filefield_sources attach to by default, and how can a custom file widget opt in?
evals.expected_output: By default it attaches to the file_generic and image_image widgets (returned by hook_filefield_sources_widgets()). A custom widget opts in by implementing hook_filefield_sources_widgets() and returning its widget plugin id.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a File field named field_ffs_known whose widget has extra filefield_sources enabled. Inspect the live default form display and list which file sources are enabled on that field's widget.
evals.expected_output: field_ffs_known has sources upload, remote and reference enabled: core.entity_form_display.node.article.default -> content.field_ffs_known.third_party_settings.filefield_sources.filefield_sources.sources = {upload, remote, reference}.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article File field field_ffs_which has exactly one extra filefield_sources source enabled besides the default Upload. Inspect the live form display and name that extra source.
evals.expected_output: The extra source is 'attach' (File attach from a server directory): content.field_ffs_which.third_party_settings.filefield_sources.filefield_sources.sources = {upload, attach}.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a File field field_ffs_task using the standard file_generic widget with only the default Upload source. Using filefield_sources, enable the 'Remote URL' (remote) source on that field's widget in the default form display, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default set content.field_ffs_task.third_party_settings.filefield_sources.filefield_sources.sources to include remote (e.g. {upload: upload, remote: remote}) - by ticking 'Remote URL' under File sources on the widget or editing the component config.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, I want editors to be able to reuse a file that's already been uploaded when filling the File field field_ffs_ref on Article, instead of only uploading a new one. Turn on the option that lets them reference an existing file, using filefield_sources, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the 'reference' (Reference existing) source on field_ffs_ref's widget: content.field_ffs_ref.third_party_settings.filefield_sources.filefield_sources.sources should include reference.
